sections.heading: Cuddalore: Gelatin, PVC and the SIPCOT Chemical Estate
paragraphs: Cuddalore's industry is chemical rather than pharmaceutical, with one notable exception. Pioneer Jellice India, a joint venture formed in 1991 between Pioneer Asia Group and Japan's Jellice Co., makes gelatin, di-calcium phosphate and other products for food and pharmaceutical use at Cuddalore. Its group has since bought 75 percent of Narmada Gelatines for Rs 103 crore in 2023 and made an open offer for India Gelatine & Chemicals in December 2024.

On the chemical side, Chemplast Sanmar set up a Rs 600 crore greenfield PVC plant on 69.5 acres allotted by SIPCOT at Semmankuppam, with a marine terminal, starting at 140,000 tonnes a year with plans for 170,000 tonnes.

sections.heading: Why a Gelatin Plant Needs Hygienic Tube
paragraphs: Gelatin sold to pharmaceutical and food customers is a product-contact material in its own right: it goes into capsules, tablets and foods. After extraction, the liquor is filtered, concentrated, sterilised and dried, and every step after the final purification is a hygienic process. Warm gelatin solutions set on cold surfaces and leave films, and protein residue in a rough bore is a microbial risk.

Electropolished 316L tube suits those post-purification lines: transfer of filtered liquor, evaporator and sterilizer connections, and the CIP circuits that clean them. Upstream bone or hide processing with acids and lime is a corrosion duty, where a pickled finish and the right grade matter more than the bore finish.

Pharmaceutical gelatin customers, capsule makers among them, audit their suppliers, and an auditor's questions about a processing line start with its material of construction and its cleaning record. A line built in traceable 316L, with a certificate for each heat and a measured finish for each electropolished lot, answers the first of those questions from the file rather than on the plant floor.

sections.heading: Chemical Units: Corrosion First, Finish Second
paragraphs: For PVC and other chemical plants in the SIPCOT estate, stainless is bought to resist the process, not for hygiene. An electropolished bore is worth specifying there only on laboratory water, sampling and analyser lines, and on transfer lines where product purity or batch-to-batch carry-over matters. Send the stream composition with the enquiry and we will say plainly whether 316L is suitable at all.

sections.heading: What a Cuddalore Buyer Should Send With an Enquiry
bullets: The plant and, for gelatin lines, whether each line is before or after the final purification step.
Temperature and cleaning regime, since warm gelatin and hot caustic CIP decide the grade and finish.
For chemical lines, chloride level, pH and temperature of the stream.
If a customer audit is due, its date, so the material documents are ready before it.
OD x wall, dimension series and metres per size; we reply with a priced quotation inside 24 hours and confirm delivery time in it.

sections.heading: Delivery to Cuddalore and SIPCOT
paragraphs: Cuddalore is supplied by road from Mumbai, with dispatch and transit confirmed in writing for each order; electropolished tube travels capped and sleeved.
